_comment: Hardware and deployment configuration for real robot pipeline

camera_intrinsics._comment: Camera intrinsic parameters (focal length, principal point)

camera_extrinsics._comment: Camera extrinsics [x, y, z, roll, pitch, yaw] - camera pose in robot base frame. Update these after running calibration.

object_meshes._comment: Paths to object mesh files for FoundationPose

yoloe_prompts._comment: YOLOE text prompts for each object

registration._comment: Registration settings and debug save directory

vla_server._comment: Point to the IP address of the VLA policy server (e.g., GPU server)

motion_planning._comment: IK_MP uses blocking motion, no control_frequency needed. Perturbations for future retry logic.

above_pose._comment: Default height above object. object_specific is placeholder for future custom handling.

vla_execution._comment: gripper > 0.5 means open (0), gripper <= 0.5 means close (1)

tracking._comment: Number of refinement iterations during tracking
